daily.brief: 過去約25小時（11月24日凌晨至25日清晨）128個帳號發了311則帖。共同看好集中在$HPE業績超預期與AI伺服器需求，以及$AMD回撤後的買入機會；共同看淡則是$SMH與$ORCL信貸擔憂。最熱鬧的$NVDA提及101次，多空帳號18對5，圍繞Jensen回歸與估值爭論。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好以AI伺服器與部分成長名稱為主。$HPE有4個帳號同向：@tenet_research分享業績回顧，收入14.55B同比+50%，非GAAP EPS 1.43，營運現金流2.3B（原帖）；@danielnewmanUV指出所有指標超預期並上調指引，強勁網絡與AI伺服器需求，且沒有neocloud信貸敞口，專注企業交易（原帖）。$AMD有3個帳號看好，@canuck2usa說回撤時買入，較高點低約39%，現在要守住395美元區域（原帖）。$LLY也有3個，@MikeZaccardi形容它繼續像會治癒癌症一樣交易，市值接近超大型AI股票（原帖）。$DELL有2個，@CKCapitalxx提到2027年第三季業績超預期，營收創紀錄549億，AI伺服器營收220億高於指引約190億（原帖）。

共同看淡

$SMH有2個帳號看淡。@OptionsMike說週一大漲後今日小幅整理，$SMH偏弱有些擔憂，但整體市場守住良好（原帖）；@SunriseTrader指日線高波動震盪偏空，半導體仍承壓，尚未顯示復甦，400美元繼續是重要水平（原帖）。$ORCL也有2個，@Mayhem4Markets引用信貸開始看起來完全混亂，三周前發行的29年債券現在更寬，CDS爆出（原帖）；@PauloMacro說信貸今天完全混亂，曲線上寬20-30，30年紙現在近390以上（原帖）。

分歧

分歧最大的是$NVDA，101則提及中多空帳號18對5。@sentimentrader指出Jensen Huang回來擔任NVIDIA CEO，半導體情緒轉折，$NVDA週一飆升31.5%，而$SOXX跳升13.6%（原帖）；@Micro2Macr0則說仍然超級便宜，NVDA仍低於10倍，SNDK SKHY MU仍為2.5-3.4倍（原帖）。@CheddarFlow提到有人繼續增加半導體看漲期權包括$AMD $NVDA $SOXL（原帖）。$QQQ多空4對1，@3PeaksTrading說如果$QQQ超過642，更廣泛市場擠壓就會變得有趣（原帖）。$ANT2對2，@3PeaksTrading看到從75.61低點出現錘子線，反彈設置正在形成（原帖），但@KeithMcCullough說他們已停止談論其AI泡沫ANT災難性IPO（原帖）。

其他值得留意

@TradexWhisperer提到$MU 75%售罄，談判轉向2028，$SKHY超過50%在LTA下簽署，實際上售罄至2029（原帖）。整體多頭觀點133，空頭38，清晰表態帳號69個。

daily.brief: Over roughly the last 25 hours (early Nov 24 to early morning Nov 25), 128 accounts posted 311 times. Shared bullish views concentrated on $HPE earnings beat and AI server demand, plus $AMD dip-buying opportunity; shared bearish focused on $SMH and $ORCL credit concerns. The busiest name $NVDA had 101 mentions with 18 bullish versus 5 bearish accounts, debating Jensen’s return and valuation.
daily.full:
Consensus

Shared bullish views centered on AI servers and selected growth names. $HPE had 4 accounts aligned: @tenet_research shared the earnings recap with revenue of $14.55B up 50% YoY, non-GAAP EPS $1.43, and operating cash flow of $2.3B (post); @danielnewmanUV noted beats across all metrics and raised guidance on strong networking and AI server demand, with no neocloud credit exposure and a focus on enterprise deals (post). $AMD had 3 bullish accounts; @canuck2usa said buy the dip, about 39% off the high, and the job now is to hold the $395 area (post). $LLY also had 3; @MikeZaccardi described it continuing to trade like it will cure cancer, approaching mega AI stocks in market cap (post). $DELL had 2; @CKCapitalxx noted the FY27 Q3 beat with record revenue of $54.9B and AI server revenue of $22B versus roughly $19B guided (post).

Shared Bearish

$SMH had 2 bearish accounts. @OptionsMike said after Monday’s big gain today was a small range, $SMH weaker with some concerns, though the broader market held well (post); @SunriseTrader noted the daily chart is high-volatility chop and leans bearish, semiconductors still under pressure with no recovery shown yet, and $400 remains an important level (post). $ORCL also had 2; @Mayhem4Markets cited credit starting to look completely messy, with the 29-year bond issued three weeks ago now wider and CDS blowing out (post); @PauloMacro said credit was completely messy today, 20-30 wider on the curve, and the 30-year paper now near 390+ (post).

Split

The largest split was on $NVDA, with 18 bullish versus 5 bearish accounts among 101 mentions. @sentimentrader noted Jensen Huang returning as NVIDIA CEO, semiconductor sentiment turning, $NVDA surging 31.5% on Monday while $SOXX jumped 13.6% (post); @Micro2Macr0 said it remains super cheap, NVDA still under 10x, and SNDK SKHY MU still at 2.5-3.4x (post). @CheddarFlow mentioned someone continuing to add semiconductor calls including $AMD $NVDA $SOXL (post). $QQQ was 4 versus 1; @3PeaksTrading said if $QQQ clears 642 then a broader market squeeze gets interesting (post). $ANT was 2 versus 2; @3PeaksTrading saw a hammer from the 75.61 low with a bounce setup forming (post), while @KeithMcCullough said they have conveniently stopped talking about their AI bubble ANT disastrous IPO (post).

Other Notable

@TradexWhisperer noted $MU 75% sold out with negotiations shifting to 2028, $SKHY over 50% signed under LTA and effectively sold out to 2029 (post). Overall 133 bullish views, 38 bearish, 69 clear accounts.
